column5:
This Degree prepares students for the specialized profession of Cybersecurity engineer, supporting industry involvement in the learning process. The latter aims to respond to the current needs of the socio-economic sector in the field of cybersecurity. This means preparing future professionals with the knowledge and skills necessary to develop both in the workplace and in the technological field.
The Degree develops a set of essential skills, including: Ensure security in the software supply chain and develop strategies to protect its ecosystem; Manage hardware security vulnerabilities, and design and implement protection solutions; Ensure secure IT/OT environments and protect against targeted threats; Identify the relationship between cybersecurity and cyber defence and manage cyber intelligence; Extract digital evidence considering current legal frameworks; and Protect the lifecycle of an AI solution. 

Possible career paths, among others, Cyber Incident Responder, Cybersecurity Researcher and Chief Information Security Officer (CISO), roles defined by the European Cybersecurity Skills Framework (ECSF).

Study program focused on industrial security, developed in collaboration with leading cybersecurity companies, including partnerships with Palo Alto Networks and Check Point Software Technologies. Potential career paths include roles such as Cybersecurity Implementer, Cybersecurity Risk Manager, or Cybersecurity Researcher specializing in the security of industrial systems and critical infrastructures. These roles align with the European Cybersecurity Skills Framework (ECSF).

Das Studienkonzept bietet das problembasierte Lernen als Lernform: vorgegebene Probleme aus der Praxis werden weitgehend selbstständig, handlungs- und praxisorientiert gelöst.

Mit den erworbenen Kompetenzen kannst du als Absolventin oder Absolvent des Studiengangs Cyber Security Managements für Unternehmen wichtige Schlüsselaufgaben in der prozessualen und organisatorischen Informationssicherheit, im IT-Betrieb und in der Informationstechnik  übernehmen.

column2: Cybersecurity specialisation for Computer Science & Engineering Masters degree
column5: The student specialising in cybersecurity will be able to design, develop, test and evaluate systems, software or hardware for security goals in the ever evolving digital landscape. Possible career paths as Cybersecurity Implementer or Cybersecurity Architect or Penetration Tester, roles defined by the European Cybersecurity Skills Framework (ECSF).

The MSc in Cybersecurity at EUC addresses the increasing demand for innovative approaches to the complexities and multidisciplinary character of cyber security policy and practice.  Students are equipped with technical skills and an understanding of law, risk management, ethical hacking and cryptography as these relate to cybersecurity.

Possible career paths as Cyber Legal, Policy & Compliance Officer or Penetration Tester or Cybersecurity Architect, roles defined by the European Cybersecurity Skills Framework (ECSF).

column2: MSc in Advanced Cybersecurity Technologies and Governance
column5: The M.Sc. «Advanced Cybersecurity Technologies and Governance» is interdisciplinary and cross-sectoral in nature and focuses on the specialization of scientists in the fields of cybersecurity, data protection, and governance of relevant environments. The purpose of the M.Sc. is the advancement of scientific knowledge in the fields of cybersecurity technologies, data protection, and governance of relevant environments. Within this context, graduates of the program will be able to work professionally in matters related to cybersecurity technologies, data protection, and governance of relevant environments in businesses and organizations of the private and public sector, as well as produce new knowledge within related research initiatives. It is mostly tailored for the ECSF profiles of Cyber Legal, Policy & Compliance Officer, Cyber Incident Responder, Cybersecurity Architect, although it cover several topics appropriate to more than just those three ECSF roles.

column1: University of National and World Economy (UNWE)
National University of Science and Technology POLITEHNICA Bucharest
column5:
Training cybersecurity experts provides the necessary framework for the proper implementation of security tools within organisations. Electronic governance requires robust cybersecurity standards, while new vulnerabilities, risks, and threats to organisational security continue to emerge. The need for cybersecurity experts is therefore increasingly evident in a society where electronic information is pervasive.
Students and graduates of the Master’s programme work for leading companies in Romania and abroad, Romanian government institutions with responsibilities in cybersecurity, and state-owned enterprises. Graduates may also pursue a research career through doctoral studies at the National University of Science and Technology POLITEHNICA Bucharest, ICI Bucharest.

The Advanced Cyber Security programme is recommended for graduates in Engineering Sciences, particularly those holding a bachelor’s degree in Computer Engineering and Information Technology, as well as for professionals in computer science.

The programme is particularly aligned with the ECSF professional profiles of Cybersecurity Implementer, Cybersecurity Architect, and Cybersecurity Researcher.
Applications für the study year 2024 are possible anytime until end of June 2024.
column18: ISO 27001 Certified Auditor, Microsoft Azure, VMware, Barracuda, LPI

column5:
The Cybersecurity Degree is a 3-year programme that provides students with a 
comprehensive understanding of concepts, techniques, and tools required to secure 
software applications, computer systems and networks. Students will increase their 
proficiency in the usage of open source operating systems, network security, database 
programming, digital forensics, and offensive security. They will also develop practical 
skills in mitigating cyber threats.
The programme includes work-based component, whereby one’s own skills are put to 
good use by working alongside experienced cybersecurity professionals.

column5:
Our Master Programme in Cybersecurity equips you with the skills to protect systems from cyber threats, preparing you for digitalization challenges. Expertise in cybersecurity is essential for safeguarding society.

Potential career paths are Cyber Incident Responder, Cyber Threat Intelligence Specialist,  Penetration Tester, roles defined by the European Cybersecurity Skills Framework (ECSF).

The programme is offered both on campus and online, with all teaching conducted in English.

O Mestrado em Cibersegurança (MCS) da Universidade do Minho é um programa de 120 ECTS (2 anos), lecionado no Departamento de Informática, em Braga. Forma profissionais capazes de pensar como adversários, conceber sistemas resilientes e liderar a estratégia de segurança das organizações. O currículo articula fundamentos técnicos sólidos (segurança de sistemas, redes, dados e software, criptografia, tolerância a intrusões, análise de tráfego de rede), competências organizacionais e legais (gestão de cibersegurança, gestão de incidentes, aspetos legais) e formação prática intensiva em Laboratórios de Cibersegurança e desafios Capture the Flag. No 3.º e 4.º semestres, os estudantes desenvolvem uma dissertação de investigação original (45 ECTS), com propostas de origem académica ou industrial, avaliadas sob o mesmo procedimento rigoroso. Possíveis percursos profissionais, segundo o European Cybersecurity Skills Framework (ECSF): Cybersecurity Architect, Cybersecurity Researcher e Cyber Incident Responder. Língua de ensino: Português.

column2: Master Universitario di II livello in Cybersecurity: Politiche pubbliche, normative e gestione
column5: Il Master forma professionisti per ruoli chiave definiti dall'European Cybersecurity Skills Framework (ECSF), come il Chief Information Security Officer (CISO), il Legal Policy & Compliance Officer e il Cybersecurity Risk Manager. Il programma approfondisce temi giuridici, di policy, tecnici, manageriali e di gestione del rischio; integra altresì lo studio della cybersecurity con la data protection e le opportunità offerte dall'intelligenza artificiale, fornendo così una formazione completa e pratica. Quattro certificazioni riconosciute, stage e opportunità di networking arricchiscono ulteriormente l’esperienza, rendendo il Master accessibile anche a chi non possiede un background tecnico.

column1: University of Maribor, Faculty of Electrical Engineering and Computer Science
column5:
In the study programme Informatics and Data Technologies, students learn how to apply and transfer fundamental engineering knowledge into practice, solve professional, technical and organisational challenges of computerisation and digitalisation using engineering methods, and develop advanced IT solutions and services.
The study programme covers all areas of design, development and implementation of information systems, IS/IT architectures, data technologies, web solutions and services, decision-making systems, programming, information security, development of mobile and cloud solutions, data engineering and project management. It also covers future technologies such as machine learning, digital forensics and blockchain technology.

Σκοπός του μεταπτυχιακού προγράμματος "Ασφάλεια Υπολογιστών και Δικτύων" είναι η προαγωγή των αρχών που διέπουν την ασφάλεια υπολογιστών, την ασφαλή λειτουργία των δικτύων και την ασφάλεια κυβερνοχώρου (Cybersecurity). Το Πρόγραμμα καλύπτει τις αρχές σχεδιασμού των επικοινωνιακών δικτύων, τη δικανική (Forensic) υπολογιστών και δικτύων, την ασφάλεια υπολογιστών, δικτύων και κυβερνοχώρου, θέματα κρυπτογραφίας, θέματα ασφάλειας σε ασύρματα δίκτυα καθώς και θέματα που διέπουν τη Διαχείριση Κινδύνων Ασφαλείας σε Πληροφοριακά και Επικοινωνιακά Συστήματα.
Πιθανοί επαγγελματικοί ρόλοι, σύμφωνα με το Ευρωπαϊκό Πλαίσιο Δεξιοτήτων Κυβερνοασφάλειας (ECSF):
- Chief Information Security Officer (CISO)
- Digital Forensics Investigator
- Penetration Tester

The Master’s Degree in Cybersecurity responds to the growing need for trained specialists with high scientific and technological expertise in the field of cybersecurity. To this end, it provides its graduates with a deep knowledge of the scientific foundations, methodologies and technologies of the area, which allows them to contribute to the advancement of knowledge and to be able to deal with cybersecurity issues in the most diverse application areas. The course is entirely delivered in English.
The master is offered by the departments of Information Engineering and of Computer Science.
Possible career paths as a Cyber Threat Intelligence Specialist or Cybersecurity Implementer or Cybersecurity Researcher, roles defined by the European Cybersecurity Skills Framework (ECSF).

column1: Campus Internacional de Ciberseguridad (ENIIT Business School)
column5:
El Máster en Ciberseguridad realizado en colaboración con Telefónica Tech, aborda los aspectos esenciales del mundo de la seguridad informática y capacita al alumno, para trabajar en un sector profesional en auge.
Posible trayectoria profesional según los roles definidos por el European Cybersecurity Skills Framework (ECSF):
- Chief Information Security Officer (CISO)

Studia II stopnia na kierunku bezpieczeństwo wewnętrzne, specjalność „Specjalista ds. bezpieczeństwa cyberprzestrzeni” odpowiada na rosnące w dobie cyfryzacji zapotrzebowanie na  specjalistów z zakresu bezpieczeństwa w IT. Obejmuje analizę przypadków naruszenia bezpieczeństwa teleinformatycznego, reagowania na incydenty naruszenia bezpieczeństwa IT oraz zapoznaje z systemami dbającymi o bezpieczeństwo teleinformatyczne. Przygotowuje absolwentów do pracy na stanowiskach funkcjonariuszy i urzędników w administracji samorządowej i publicznej ds. ochrony informacji niejawnych. Możliwe ścieżki kariery jako Chief Information Security Officer (CISO) lub Cyber Legal, Policy & Compliance Officer, role określone przez European Cybersecurity Skills Framework (ECSF).

column1: Hochschule Niederrhein University of Applied Science
column5: In this new, innovative degree programme, which was developed in collaboration with cybercrime professionals, you can expect an application-oriented range of learning topics, from the basics of computer science, network and computer technology, cyber security and criminalistics to specific methods and procedures for obtaining and presenting forensic evidence. The programme is divided into a subject-specific foundation course (semesters one and two), an application-oriented expert course in digital forensics (semesters three and four), an individual specialisation semester (semester five) and a practical phase including the bachelor's thesis (semester six). Graduates can develop an individual subject-specific competence profile within the framework of elective modules and topics in the projects offered each semester or through the practical phase and their final thesis. If you are interested, our curriculum also allows you to gain experience abroad through the mobility window in the 5th semester. You can find more details in our curricula and module handbooks.

column1: University of A Coruña / University of Vigo
column5:
In the Inter-University Master in Cybersecurity (MUniCS), we prepare professionals in digital security by combining science, technology, challenges and business practices. The teaching combines computing, engineering and management to develop skills in the safeguarding of information and cyber-physical systems.
Possible career paths as Cyber Incident Responder, Cyber Threat Intelligence Specialist and Cybersecurity Architect, roles defined by the European Cybersecurity Skills Framework (ECSF).

The Master’s programme in Network Forensics has a multidisciplinary connection to technology and social sciences. During the programme, you build theoretical and practical skills for work in IT forensic network analysis. You also develop in-depth knowledge of data mining, cybersecurity and investigation into cybercrime.

The programme maps to the following European Cybersecurity Skills Framework (ECSF) roles:
- Digital Forensics Investigator
- Cyber Incident Responder
- Cyber Threat Intelligent Specialist
column18: Cisco CyberOps Associate, Cisco Certificate in Ethical Hacking

column5:
The Master's programme "Cyber Security and Risk Management" provides a strong foundation and in-depth technical knowledge in security, privacy, and cryptography. Students study cybersecurity theory and management, risk analysis, cryptography, network security, cyberdefense, digital forensics, cybercrime, cyberlaw and policy, and data communications and networking, gaining skills applicable across industries such as finance, healthcare, IT, the public sector, and the Internet of Things, all of which require protection from cyberattacks and data breaches.

Given the rise of cyber threats, demand for well-prepared professionals is growing steadily, opening varied and well-compensated career paths such as security analyst, network administrator, cryptography specialist, and security consultant. Graduates are prepared for roles such as Cybersecurity Engineer or Information Security Analyst, corresponding to the ENISA ECSF profiles of Cybersecurity Risk Manager, Cyber Legal, Policy and Compliance Officer, and Digital Forensics Investigator.

O Mestrado em Cibersegurança e Resiliência (MCSR) oferece uma formação interdisciplinar assente nos três pilares fundamentais da cibersegurança: pessoas, processos e tecnologia. Este programa prepara os estudantes para conceberem estratégias e soluções de cibersegurança e desenvolvimento de resiliência organizacional. O curso foca-se na proteção contra ciberataques (cibersegurança), assim como na prevenção de danos e possíveis impactos negativos que possam ocorrer como consequência desses ataques (ciber-resiliência).

Com uma abordagem inovadora e um formato híbrido, o mestrado destina-se tanto a recém-licenciados como a profissionais que pretendam aprofundar competências nesta área crítica e em constante evolução. Beneficiando da forte ligação do Iscte a empresas e instituições do setor, o curso alia uma base teórica sólida a uma forte componente prática e de investigação aplicada.
Possíveis trajetórias de carreira incluem funções como Chief Information Security Officer (CISO), Cybersecurity Architect e Cybersecurity Implementer, entre outras funções definidas no European Cybersecurity Skills Framework (ECSF).

Gebeten door security en wil je hackers geen kans geven? Ben jij klaar om de digitale wereld te verdedigen? Dan zit je bij ons afstudeertraject Cloud & Cyber Security op de juiste plek.

In dit unieke traject ontdek je hoe je onze maatschappij kan verdedigen tegen de miljoenen aanvallen die dagelijks gebeuren. Al doende leer je via veel praktijkvakken en toffe projecten het laatste nieuwe in de wereld van netwerken, cloud applicaties, privacy en cybersecurity. Je verdiept je in technieken en tactieken om cyberdreigingen te detecteren en tegen te houden. Je bouwt hiervoor een eigen Security Operations Center (SOC) in ons educatief datacenter. Met een combinatie van offensieve (Red Team) en defensieve (Blue Team) securitytechnieken trek je mee ten strijde tegen cybercrime.

Na je studie kan je aan de slag als defender van cyberspace. En werkzekerheid? Gegarandeerd! 98% van onze studenten vindt binnen de drie maanden werk. Wil jij onze samenleving beschermen door een sterke digitale beveiliging op te zetten? Kies dan voor dit traject en zet de eerste stap naar een carrière in cybersecurity!
column18: LPI, CCNA, VCP, CEH, CompTIA+, Cisco CyberOps

column1: National University of Science and Technology POLITEHNICA Bucharest
column5:
The Digital4Security Hybrid Master’s programme is a two-year, 120 ECTS degree delivered in English and awarded by POLITEHNICA Bucharest. 

Designed for working professionals, it combines online and self-directed learning with intensive in-person activities, offering advanced training in cybersecurity management, data sovereignty, organisational resilience, security operations, enterprise and cloud architecture, artificial intelligence, governance, compliance, auditing, and cyber-physical risk management. The programme integrates strategic, technical, legal, and practical perspectives, preparing graduates to lead cybersecurity initiatives, manage organisational risks, ensure regulatory compliance, and support secure digital transformation. 

The programme is particularly aligned with the European Cybersecurity Skills Framework (ECSF) professional profiles of Chief Information Security Officer (CISO), Cybersecurity Risk Manager, and Cyber Legal, Policy & Compliance Officer.

På TopUp uddannelsen Pba i IT-sikkerhed vil du blive undervist i mange facetter af IT-sikkerhedsområdet. På studiet vil du blive mødt af en helhedsopfattelse omkring IT-sikkerhed, hvor arbejdet med det tekniske kombineres med det teoretiske, således at forståelsen for kompleksiteten af IT-sikkerhedsarbejdet bliver konkret. Et eksempel kunne være implementeringen af Systemsikkerhed, der kan kobles til de generelle retningslinjer og standarder for området.

Protecting information and digital assets from various forms of threats, attacks, disasters and mistakes is important for individuals, organizations and companies. Concepts and topics that are covered within the master’s programme include information security, cybersecurity, network security, organizational security, IT security policies, legal aspects of security, personal privacy and data protection, and governance of information security in organizations. The programme also covers topics related to crime science, for example, digital forensics, intelligence analysis and technologies and methods for analysing social media.
Possible career paths according to the roles defined by the European Cybersecurity Skills Framework (ECSF):
- Cybersecurity Risk Manager
- Digital Forensics Investigator
- Cybersecurity Implementer

El Máster en Ciberseguridad de OBS facilita a profesionales y directivos la definición de estrategias y el conocimiento de herramientas que permiten trabajar en torno a la seguridad de los datos, enfocados a garantizar la continuidad en las operaciones y la permanencia en los mercados.

Posibles trayectorias profesionales según lo definido por los roles del European Cybersecurity Skills Framework (ECSF):
- Cybersecurity Auditor
- Cybersecurity Risk Manager
- Digital Forensics Investigator

column1: School of Management and Technology - Polytechnic of Porto
column5: The Degree in Computer Security in Computer Networks provides technical and scientific training for the exercise of various computer activities, related to the Administration of Computer Systems, Installation and Management of Computer Networks, Programming of Computer Systems and CyberSecurity. This degree is taught by professors with an academic career and by specialists who carry out professional activities in prominent companies. The transmission of skills follows a study model of learning by doing.

This master aims at training Information Security Managers. It corresponds to a second year of master.
Admission requirements:  Bachelor and 3 years of experience or Master in a related field + individual interview.
This is a life-long learning program. Sessions are held on Fridays and Saturdays.
The programme is supported by two professional associations: CLUSIL and CPSI.

Possible career path as Chief Information Security Officer (CISO), a role defined by the European Cybersecurity Skills Framework (ECSF).

column2: Master's Degree in Computer Security and Artificial Intelligence - Online
column5:
We offer an online master's degree carried out in two semesters. Compulsory subjects (36 ECTS) cover topics of artificial intelligence and computer security. The remaining, 15 ECTS, are optional and allow specialization in one of the mentioned areas. The average student's workload is 15h per week for a period of nine months. 
All activity is done online with no timetable. 
Possible career paths as a Cybersecurity Researcher or Cybersecurity Implementer, roles defined by the European Cybersecurity Skills Framework (ECSF).

The Master’s program in Information Systems and Communications Security (SSIC) is a two-year study program dedicated to training specialists in cybersecurity and the protection of information and communication systems. The program aims to develop the skills required to identify, prevent, and manage cyber threats, as well as to design and implement modern security solutions within organizations.
The curriculum focuses on current technologies and fields such as cybersecurity, IT infrastructures, digital communications, cloud computing, artificial intelligence, and data protection. It provides both a solid theoretical foundation and practical applications relevant to the professional environment. 
The program is intended for graduates with university degrees in computer science, engineering, and related fields who wish to deepen their knowledge and pursue a career in cybersecurity, one of the most dynamic and in-demand sectors of the IT job market. Possible career paths according to the European Cybersecurity Skills Framework (ECSF): Cybersecurity Implementer, Cyber Incident Responder, and Cybersecurity Architect.

column1: La Salle Campus Barcelona - Ramon Llull University
column5:
The Master's Degree in Cybersecurity at La Salle-URL (MCS) aims to help fulfil this business need and trains experts specialised in ICT security, incorporating the key skills in both defensive and offensive cybersecurity with a focus on such indispensable aspects as reverse engineering, cyberintelligence and forensic analysis, among others.
Possible career paths as Penetration Tester, Digital Forensics Investigator and Cyber Threat Intelligence Specialist, roles defined by the European Cybersecurity Skills Framework (ECSF).

This programme is restricted to law enforcement investigators and focuses mainly on digital forensics although it has relevance for cybersecurity practitioners in government and law enforcement.
Possible career path as a Digital Forensics Investigator, a role defined by the European Cybersecurity Skills Framework (ECSF).

column1: Gheorghe Asachi Technical University of Iași
column5:
The Master's programme ""Cyberspace Security"" is offered within the Faculty of Automatic Control and Computers and is structured over 4 semesters, totaling 120 ECTS credits. It trains specialists able to drive innovation and meet the demands of a dynamic labor market, addressing both graduates of technical faculties (computer science, automatic control, informatics, telecommunications) and IT professionals seeking to deepen their expertise.

The curriculum is applied and up to date, covering cryptology, hardware security, web, Cloud, IoT, and mobile device security, as well as advanced topics such as IT forensics, reverse engineering, and quantum computing applications in security.

Graduates acquire the competencies to assess risks, manage cybersecurity incidents, and design secure systems, preparing them for roles such as Cybersecurity Engineer, Ethical Hacker, Security Architect, Penetration Tester, or Digital Forensic Examiner, corresponding to the ENISA ECSF profiles of Cybersecurity Architect, Penetration Tester, and Digital Forensics Investigator.

The Laurea Magistrale in Cybersecurity of the Sapienza University of Rome is a 2-year master degree which is characterized by an interdisciplinary offering that collects contributions from computer science, engineering, statistics, legal-economic sciences, along with specific knowledge of the major application domain of cybersecurity. This master's degree is taught only in English.
Possible career paths as Cybersecurity Architect, Cybersecurity Researcher and Penetration Tester, roles defined by the European Cybersecurity Skills Framework (ECSF).

column1: The Lucian Blaga University of Sibiu
column5:
The Master's programme in Cybersecurity is designed to train advanced professionals in the field of cybersecurity, providing the essential theoretical and practical knowledge needed to protect IT infrastructure through both defensive systems and an understanding of the attack techniques used by entities that carry out penetration attempts against information systems' security structures.

The programme is addressed to bachelor's graduates in technical fields such as computer science, computer engineering, telecommunications, or other related disciplines, who wish to deepen their knowledge and skills in information security. 

Graduates of the programme will acquire advanced competencies in assessing risks and implementing security solutions; managing and responding to security incidents; applying security principles in the design and administration of networks and information systems; developing and evaluating cybersecurity policies; and collaborating within multidisciplinary teams to protect critical infrastructures, preparing them for roles corresponding to the ENISA ECSF profiles of Cybersecurity Architect, Cyber Incident Responder, and Cybersecurity Risk Manager.

Organizational and IT security is an interdisciplinary field that deals with the security of information, IT systems and business processes in companies and institutions. It combines aspects of computer science, business management and law to identify risks, develop protective measures and implement security strategies.

In addition to technical measures, organizational security concepts play a crucial role. This includes risk management, security guidelines, compliance requirements and the training of employees in order to minimize human mistakes and social engineering attacks.

The focus of the "Organizational and IT Security" course at THM is on the development and implementation of holistic security concepts. Students learn to design security architectures, analyze weaknesses and to develop practical security solutions for organizations. Some courses are offered in English. 

This is a 7 semesters long program and a mandatory internship (6th and 7th semester) is a part of the program.

column1: University of Žilina, Faculty of Security Engineering
column5:
Absolvent študijného programu Bezpečnostný manažment na druhom stupni má komplexné teoretické poznatky, praktické zručnosti a skúsenosti z oblastí riadenia ľudských zdrojov a projektovania, prevádzkovania a hodnotenia vo vzťahu k účinnosti, efektívnosti, spoľahlivosti a kvality systémov ochrany osôb a majetku, ako súčasť prevencie kriminality a inej protispoločenskej činnosti.

Pozná a aplikuje stochastické a deterministické metódy procesov manažmentu rizík, manažmentu incidentov a manažmentu kontinuity činností. 
Absolvent študijného programu Bezpečnostný manažment má počas inžinierskeho štúdia možnosť sa profilovať v oblasti fyzickej a objektovej bezpečnosti a informačnej bezpečnosti.

Pozná pojmy, vzťahy, subjekty a aktíva informačných systémov (napr. informácie, dáta, hardvér, softvér, dodávatelia, lokality), sietí a moderných informačných technológií v organizácií vo väzbe na ich informačnú, resp. kybernetickú bezpečnosť. Pozná a vie aplikovať požiadavky na ochranu fyzických osôb pri spracúvaní osobných údajov a voľnom pohybe takýchto údajov. Pozná problematiku sieťovej bezpečnosti a má adekvátne konfiguračné zručnosti.

Možné kariérne cesty ako Chief Information Security Officer (CISO) a Cybersecurity Risk Manager, role definované v rámci European Cybersecurity Skills Framework (ECSF).

El máster oficial en Ciberseguridad de la UI1 brinda los conocimientos necesarios para comenzar a trabajar en cualquier campo de la ciberseguridad, es un máster eminentemente práctico, con una duración de un año, también oferta un itinerario para su realización en 2 años. Ofrece la posibilidad de realizar prácticas en diversas empresas españolas.

Posibles trayectorias profesionales según los roles definidos por el European Cybersecurity Skills Framework (ECSF) :
- Cybersecurity Auditor
- Penetration tester
- Digital Forensics Investigator

The MSc programme teaches the foundations of AI and Cybersecurity, with a strong focus on hands on learning.  Students have the freedom to select an individual focus of study (within the areas of AI and Cybersecurity), and project based learning is encouraged. This is a joint programme with the University of Udine: students who achieve sufficient credits in Udine are awarded a double degree. 
Possible career paths as Cybersecurity Researcher, Cybersecurity Implementer and Cyber Threat Intelligence Specialist, roles defined by the European Cybersecurity Skills Framework (ECSF).

For detailed information concerning the Programme, please visit the university page on https://fenix.ciencias.ulisboa.pt/degrees/seguranca-informatica-564500436615446.

Possible career paths as Cybersecurity Architect, Cybersecurity Implementer, Cyber Threat Intelligence Specialist and others, roles defined by the European Cybersecurity Skills Framework (ECSF).

Das Studium findet berufsbegleitend statt, an 3 Abenden pro Woche von 17:30-20:45, fallweise Samstags. Inhaltlich liegt der Fokus auf den technischen Aspekten der IT-Security, aufgeteilt in die Säulen "sichere Softwareentwicklung", "Netzwerksicherheit" und "Penetration Testing/Forensik". Mögliche Karrierewege als Cybersecurity Implementer oder Cybersecurity Researcher oder Penetration Tester, Rollen definiert durch das European Cybersecurity Skills Framework (ECSF).

Studia  „bezpieczeństwo wewnętrzne” to studia interdyscyplinarne. Efekty i treści kształcenia obejmują przygotowanie
z dziedzin nauk społecznych, ekonomicznych i prawnych, w szczególności dyscyplin: nauki o bezpieczeństwie, nauki o obronności, nauki o polityce, nauki o zarządzaniu i prawo. Zapewniają przede wszystkim wieloaspektowe przygotowanie w zakresie organizacji i funkcjonowania administracji bezpieczeństwa publicznego w Polsce. 
Studia w specjalności „specjalista ds. bezpieczeństwa w cyberprzestrzeni” przygotowują absolwentów do pracy na stanowiskach funkcjonariuszy, urzędników.

The MSc provides its students with a solid and in-depth education, in line with the needs of innovation in the field of computer engineering. Students can choose among three tracks, namely: Computer Systems and Networks, Cyber-physical systems, and Cybersecurity. The Cybersecurity track focuses on the design of secure systems and applications.
Possible career paths as Cybersecurity Risk Manager, Cybersecurity Researcher and Cybersecurity Implementer, roles defined by the European Cybersecurity Skills Framework (ECSF).
column18: Abilitazione alla professione di Ingegnere Senior

column5:
This study program provides higher interdisciplinary education in the field of information security. The study plan combines technical fields, such as applied mathematics, cryptography, informatics, and humanities, especially law. Courses are provided by the Faculty of Electrical Engineering and Communication, Brno University of Technology. The aim of this program is to fully prepare experts in the field of information security who will be able to technically carry out mechanisms and systems of cyber security with respect to the Czech and international legislation´s requirements.
Possible career paths as Penetration Tester, Cybersecurity Implementer and Chief Information Security Officer (CISO), roles defined by the European Cybersecurity Skills Framework (ECSF).

column2: Master In Cybersecurity and Cyber Defence
column5:
This Master offers a unique and broad interdisciplinary training that builds from information and system security, threats and incidents management and analysis, and cyber defence research methods. Taught by leading experts in the field with attention to providing a well-balanced mix of theoretical and practical instruction, the programme prepares students to work in the growing professional fields of cybersecurity and cyber defence and also trains them to pursue a future in research and academia from a doctoral level, following graduation.

Possible career paths as Chief Information Security Officer (CISO), Cyber Legal, Policy & Compliance Officer, Cybersecurity Risk Manager, Cyber Threat Intelligence Specialist and other roles defined by the European Cybersecurity Skills Framework (ECSF).

column1: University of Žilina, Faculty of Security Engineering
column5:
Absolvent študijného programu Bezpečnostný manažment na prvom stupni má základné teoretické poznatky a praktické zručnosti a skúsenosti najmä z oblastí manažmentu a manažmentu rizík s aplikáciou na manažment vybraných oblastí bezpečnosti súkromného a verejného sektora. 
Identifikuje a tvorivo aplikuje bezpečnostné požiadavky právneho a normatívneho rámca vybraných oblastí bezpečnosti súvisiacich s ochranou osôb,  majetku a informácií primárne pred úmyselnými antropogénnymi hrozbami (vznikajúce úmyselnou činnosťou človeka).

Definuje, obsluhuje, prevádzkuje a v niektorých špecifických oblastiach riadi ľudské zdroje, organizačné a technické opatrenia systému ochrany osôb, majetku a informácií ako súčasť prevencie kriminality a inej protispoločenskej činnosti. Spolupracuje na vypracovaní bezpečnostnej dokumentácie.

Absolvent študijného programu Bezpečnostný manažment má počas bakalárskeho štúdia možnosť sa profilovať v oblasti fyzickej a objektovej bezpečnosti a informačnej bezpečnosti.

Podieľa sa na vytváraní a implementovaní systémov manažérstva bezpečnosti organizácie (napr. systém manažérstva fyzickej a objektovej bezpečnosti, systém manažérstva informačnej bezpečnosti).

column2: Computer Science (with specialization in Cyber Security)
column5:
The Master's programme in Computer Science is dedicated to the highest-quality teaching in an informal learning environment. Our high-profile international teaching staff expect students to take an active part in the teaching, and staff-student consultation is always encouraged. The teaching is a mix of lectures and classes, with preparatory work in study groups.

The emphasis of the Cyber Security specialization is on learning how to design, build and analyze secure software, protocols and systems using advanced techniques and theories from cryptography, program analysis and semantics.

Possible career paths as Cybersecurity Researcher and Cybersecurity Architect, roles defined by the European Cybersecurity Skills Framework (ECSF).

The education is based on Problem Based Learning, where problem based project work is a core component. This makes it possible to apply the theory in solving real-world problems, often in collaboration with companies or ongoing research projects.

The students can choose to specialise in technical security or security governance - this depends on the projects and electives chosen.

Possible career paths as a Cybersecurity Researcher or Cybersecurity Implementer or Cybersecurity Architect, roles defined by the European Cybersecurity Skills Framework (ECSF).

Die globale Vernetzung, der wachsende internationale Datenaustausch, die Offenheit des Internets aber auch neue Technologien wie maschinelles Lernen erfordern vorbereitende, vorbeugende, erkennende und reaktive Sicherheitsmaßnahmen. Dazu gehören zum Beispiel strukturierte Risikoanalysen, sichere Softwareentwicklung, sicheres Netzwerkmanagement, Gestaltung und Implementierung von Sicherheitsrichtlinien, Backup und Desaster Recovery Strategien, Forensik, ein organisiertes IT-Incident-Management oder aber auch aktive Penetration Tests.

Um all das zu entwickeln, braucht es technische Kenntnisse, aber auch betriebswirtschaftliches Denken. Der Studiengang Unternehmens- und IT-Sicherheit vereint daher die Kompetenzfelder IT-Sicherheit, Informationstechnologie und Betriebswirtschaft.

column1: Ştefan cel Mare University of Suceava
column5:
The "Cybersecurity" programme is a professional master's programme oriented toward training specialists capable of protecting information systems, networks, and applications against cyber threats. The curriculum takes an integrated approach to cryptographic security, protection against attacks, cloud infrastructure security, security management and auditing, and the securing of IoT systems through artificial intelligence and machine learning techniques, alongside data protection within the legislative context. 

Students develop essential competencies such as risk analysis and management, the definition of security strategies and policies, system testing and auditing, vulnerability identification, and the implementation of protective measures, in accordance with current standards and regulations.
Graduates may pursue positions such as cybersecurity expert, digital investigations expert, security auditor or consultant, and security administrator, being prepared to effectively manage the security of systems and information, in roles corresponding to the ENISA ECSF profiles of Cybersecurity Architect, Digital Forensics Investigator, and Cybersecurity Auditor.

These studies provide knowledge, skills and competences in the field of modern digital threats, security of information systems, legal aspects of cybersecurity, cryptographic aspects of data protection, risk management in the field of cybersecurity, network security systems and data mining in cybersecurity. Possible career paths as Chief Information Security Officer (CISO) or Cyber Legal, Policy & Compliance Officer, roles defined by the European Cybersecurity Skills Framework (ECSF).

Graduates of this course are qualified to deal with ICT security challenges and are prepared to identify and assess risks, vulnerabilities and cybersecurity threats, being able to plan, implement, manage and maintain the security of information systems and communication networks. They will also be equipped with knowledge and skills in implementing and carrying out continuous monitoring operations and detection of cybersecurity threats, incident investigation and reporting, and in cryptographic mechanisms for information protection.

The Master's programme "Cybersecurity and Quantum Technologies" is primarily intended for graduates of bachelor's programmes in Computers and Information Technology, Applied Automation and Systems Engineering, Electronics Engineering and Telecommunications, Applied Automation, or Mathematics-Computer Science, but may also be pursued by graduates of other related study programmes.

The training of cybersecurity specialists will be based on introducing cybersecurity concepts, information security methods, and organizational vulnerability assessment, while acquiring practical skills in identifying threats, risks, and security breaches, implementing robust security infrastructures through software and hardware methodologies, protecting critical infrastructures, and managing security incidents. The educational content responds to the demands of today's highly interconnected and digitalized modern society, preparing graduates for roles corresponding to the ENISA ECSF profiles of Cybersecurity Architect, Cyber Incident Responder, and Digital Forensics Investigator.

column1: Campus Internacional de Ciberseguridad (ENIIT Business School)
column5:
El Máster en Ciberinteligencia ofrece a los alumnos la capacidad de analizar, evaluar, interpretar e integrar información para poder realizar un análisis completo de ciberinteligencia.
Posible trayectoria profesional según los roles definidos por el European Cybersecurity Skills Framework (ECSF):
- Cyber Threat Intelligence Specialist

column1: Campus Internacional de Ciberseguridad (ENIIT Business School)
column2: Máster en Desarrollo Seguro y DevSecOps
column5:
El Máster en Desarrollo Seguro y DevSecOps, nace de la necesidad de aunar esfuerzos en el desarrollo del software, la operación del software, la seguridad requerida desde el diseño y sus consecuentes fases en el ciclo de vida del desarrollo de software. La necesidad de disponer de seguridad desde el análisis y diseño de las soluciones software, así como de garantizar la seguridad en las operaciones es dónde radica esta necesidad. Al finalizar el master, el alumno será capaz de instaurar un flujo de trabajo en el que se integran estas tres capacidades en actuación. 
El objetivo es que el alumno muestre un perfil potente (seguridad, sistemas, desarrollo) ante las necesidades que surgen en la gran mayoría de empresas con la implantación de DevSecOps en la organización. Los alumnos tendrán conocimientos avanzados para poder integrar un pipeline desde cero, automatizar todos los procesos del pipeline, así como monitorizar y evaluar la seguridad en cada punto. Un perfil todoterreno.
Posibles trayectorias profesionales según los roles definidos por el European Cybersecurity Skills Framework (ECSF):
- Cybersecurity Architect
- Cybersecurity Implementer

The MSc Cybersecurity and Data Science (formerly known as in Distributed Systems, Security) aims at the fusion of cybersecurity and data science at a Postgraduate level. It involves three tracks: (1) Information and Communication Systems Security.  (2) Infrastructure and Systems Security and Reliability and (3)  Business and Data Analytics. Possible career paths as a Cybersecurity Implementer or Penetration Tester or Chief Information Security Officer (CISO), roles defined by the European Cybersecurity Skills Framework (ECSF).
column18: ISO 27001 Auditor, EC-Council certifications, Fortinet certifications

column1: University of Maribor, Faculty of Criminal Justice and Security
column5: Študijski program *Informacijska varnost* je namenjen usposabljanju za vloge po Evropskem okviru veščin za kibernetsko varnost (ECSF) [1] prvi posredovalec pri kibernetskih incidentih (Cyber Incident Responder), [2] specialist za obveščevalno dejavnost o kibernetskih grožnjah (Cyber Threat Intelligence Specialist) in [3] revizor informacijske varnosti (Cybersecurity Auditor). Študij je izrazito interdisciplinaren in obsega področja, kot so računalništvo, management in pravo. Študenti tako s samostojnim kot skupinskim delom pridobijo teoretična in praktična znanja o preprečevanju ter odzivanju na kibernetske incidente in razumevanju strategij za učinkovito varovanje informacij.

column2: Master in Data Analysis, Cybersecurity and Cloud Computing
column5:
The main objective of this master's degree is to train students to manage and run significant real projects within the field of data analysis, cybersecurity and/or development and operations, integrating transformative technologies and tools at the forefront of knowledge.
Possible career paths as Chief Information Security Officer (CISO), Cybersecurity Implementer and Cybersecurity Auditor, roles defined by the European Cybersecurity Skills Framework (ECSF).

The program aims at preparing cybersecurity professionals by forming the systematic view on root causes of information security issues, their prevention, solving and compensation methods, providing students with the newest knowledge and abilities on modern information security insurance methods and technologies, developing original and critical thinking, managerial and innovation skills.

Possible career paths as a Chief Information Security Officer (CISO), Cybersecurity Architect and Digital Forensics Investigator, roles defined by the European Cybersecurity Skills Framework (ECSF).

The course is taught in Portuguese by default, and in English if necessary.
All classes take 3 hours and are mainly concentrated on Fridays (9-19) and Saturdays (9-16).

The course has 4 semesters (last one for the thesis only).
There are core subjects and electives.
Topics include algorithms, software engineering, IT, laws, risk management, vulnerability management and forensics.
Most subjects have 6 ECTS (8 hours of work per week).

The course teachers include industry professionals, namely from police forensic departments, risk management consulting, and critical software development.

Possible career paths as: Cybersecurity Implementer, Penetration Tester and Cyber Incident Responder, roles defined by the European Cybersecurity Skills Framework (ECSF).

Our Master's programme in Cybersecurity is designed to equip individuals like you, holding a bachelor's degree in computer science, computer engineering, informatics, information systems, or a related field. You'll gain a deep understanding and expertise in the methodologies, tools, and strategies you will need to address the complex issues plaguing our digital landscape.
Possible career paths are as Cyber Incident Responder, Cyber Threat Intelligence Specialist, and Penetration Tester, roles defined by the European Cybersecurity Skills Framework (ECSF).
column18: The program aligns with the CISSP certification.

column5: The study programme Information Systems and Cyber Security aims at the preparation of professionals in Information Systems and Cyber Security who will have the fundamental and applied knowledge in Informatics Engineering and develop skills required for a secure analysis, design, structuring and maintenance of information systems.

column1: Campus Internacional de Ciberseguridad (ENIIT Business School)
column2: Máster en Reversing, Análisis de Malware y Bug Hunting
column5:
Las ciberarmas y amenazas atacan en forma de programas y código maliciosos, y sin vienen manual de instrucciones. Por eso, gracias al Máster en Reversing, Análisis de Malware y Bug Hunting los alumnos serán capaces de entender todo el proceso para permitir recuperarse o incluso de prevenir algún ciberataque. 
Posibles trayectorias profesionales según los roles definidos por el European Cybersecurity Skills Framework (ECSF):
- Digital Forensics Investigator
- Cyber Incident Responder

column2: Bachelor's Degree in Cybersecurity Management and Leadership
column5: Plan de estudios y metodología con un enfoque 360º de la ciberseguridad que combina desde las habilidades de dirección y gestión de la ciberseguridad hasta los conocimientos técnicos necesarios para enfrentarse con éxito a la gestión de los diferentes equipos que integran un departamento de seguridad de la información. En el programa, se abordan los desafíos actuales y cambiantes desde el gobierno de la ciberseguridad, el análisis y gestión de riesgos, la seguridad ofensiva y defensiva, la seguridad en los desarrollos, el uso de la ciberinteligencia y la inteligencia artificial para anticipar y prevenir ciberataques, hasta la gestión de incidentes y el análisis forense. Posibles trayectorias profesionales según los roles definidos por ENISA (European Cybersecurity Skills Framework-ECSF): Cybersecurity Implementer, Cyber Legal, Policy and Compliance Officer, Digital Forensics Investigator.

Cybersecurity and artificial intelligence technologies are two of the most critical and fast-growing technological areas. Their combined use has the potential to offer significant advantages in protecting information systems. AI can potentially transform the cybersecurity field by providing more effective prevention-focused solutions. However, adopting these technologies must be done with caution, considering the risks and challenges that may arise. 
Possible career paths as Penetration Tester, Cybersecurity Auditor and Digital Forensics Investigator, roles defined by the European Cybersecurity Skills Framework (ECSF).

column5: The teaching method used in the degree is teaching in accordance with practice. Teaching uses modern state of art style digital teaching environments that offer students the opportunity to practice skills and knowledges in industry-like environments. Within the degree, there are groups that follow a Classroom learning schedule and groups that attend Blended learning schedule.

column1: Università degli Studi di Bari Aldo Moro
column5:
Il corso bilancia formazione tecnica su sviluppo di applicazioni sicure, crittografia applicata e sicurezza in sistemi distribuiti, con formazione su trattamento di dati sensibili, informatica forense e gestione della sicurezza nelle organizzazioni. A partire dal 2019/2020 due insegnamenti, per un totale di 15 CFU, sono tenuti in modalità di elearning. 
Possibili percorsi di carriera come Cyber Threat Intelligence Specialist o Cybersecurity Researcher o Penetration Tester, ruoli definiti dallo European Cybersecurity Skills Framework (ECSF).

The master's programme in Cybersecurity gives you access to all courses offered by the faculty in cybersecurity at KTH. The programme starts with mandatory courses providing an overview of the field, including a course in ethical hacking, and a solid base in the fundamental security pillar of cryptography. Mandatory in the programme are also courses that put cybersecurity in the context of ethics, law, threat actor behaviour, end-user behaviour, sustainability, and business and societal consequences of cyberattacks.

The programme maps to the following European Cybersecurity Skills Framework (ECSF) roles:
- Cybersecurity Architect
- Cybersecurity Implementer
- Penetration Tester

column2: Master in Informatics Security (MSI) / Mestrado em Segurança Informática
column5:
The Master in Informatics Security (MSI) aims to meet the demand of professionals in the area of Cyber Security and the needs created by the Network and Information Systems Security (NIS) Directive of the European Union. This course offers skills in several aspects of security such as cryptography, privacy, communications and infrastructure security, software security, and legal aspects of privacy and cybersecurity.
Possible career paths as Chief Information Security Officer (CISO) or Cybersecurity Risk Manager or Cybersecurity Architect, roles defined by the European Cybersecurity Skills Framework (ECSF).

column5: This a comprehensive programme designed to equip you with advanced skills and knowledge in the field of cybersecurity. It is aimed at students who already possess an ICT background but want to delve deeper into the field of cybersecurity, focusing on the technical aspect but also including regulatory, legal and managerial standpoints. Combining theoretical, practical and industry placement components, the pedagogical approach is grounded in practice and blends online learning with face-to-face lab sessions. Three (3) career paths defined by the European Cybersecurity Skills Framework (ECSF) that this programme could lead to are: Chief Information Security Officer (CISO), Cyber Incident Responder and Cybersecurity Architect.

column1: University of Applied Sciences St. Pölten
column5:
Mit dem Bachelor-Studium "IT Security" (wahlweise Vollzeit oder berufsbegleitend) erwerben Sie praktische Fähigkeiten in den Bereichen IT-Infrastruktur & Netzwerktechnik, Softwaresicherheit & Ethical Hacking, Betriebssysteme (inkl. Cloud und Mobile) sowie Security Management, um die digitalen Herausforderungen von morgen zu meistern.

Lehrveranstaltungen werden in Blockeinheiten unterrichtet – so können Sie sich voll und ganz auf eine Lehrveranstaltung konzentrieren und tief in die Materie eintauchen. Die praktische Anwendung und persönliche Betreuung in kleinen Gruppen stehen dabei immer im Zentrum dieser Ausbildung.
Für die Durchführung von Übungen und Projekten stehen Ihnen 5 unabhängige Labore mit modernster IT-Infrastruktur 24/7 zur Verfügung – auch von Zuhause aus.

column2: Master Universitario di II livello in Cybersecurity and Critical Infrastructure Protection
column5:
The Master trains experts in designing and managing systems based on Information and Communications Technology (ICT) and Cybersecurity (Mobile, Web, Cloud, SCADA) responsible for safeguarding the security and protection of a company's information and architectural assets, a Critical Infrastructure, or an organization.
The Master offers two specializations: IT/OT System Cyber Defense, and GRC for critical infrastructure protection and enterprise.
The lessons will be online with a part-time commitment of 3 days a week and the support of a tutor.
Possible career paths as Chief Information Security Officer (CISO), Cybersecurity Architect and Digital Forensic Investigator, roles defined by the European Cybersecurity Skills Framework (ECSF).
column18: Interested students can be directed to ISO 27001 Lead Auditor certification

column1: National University of Science and Technology POLITEHNICA Bucharest
column5:
The SRIC Master’s program prepares specialists in Computer Engineering and Information Technology, with a focus on the design, administration, security, and auditing of complex computer networks. The curriculum covers computer and network security, network protection using dedicated security equipment, mobile network infrastructures and services, the Internet of Things, network security auditing, parallel and distributed systems, as well as research activities and dissertation preparation.
The program combines theoretical instruction, practical laboratory work, and applied research, aiming to develop graduates who can identify vulnerabilities and risks, design and implement security solutions, monitor and troubleshoot network infrastructures, and prepare technical documentation and reports.
The knowledge and skills acquired through the program are particularly relevant to the European Cybersecurity Skills Framework (ECSF) professional profiles of Cybersecurity Architect, Cybersecurity Implementer, and Cybersecurity Auditor.

The four-year Professional Bachelor Study Programme in Cyber Security offers students the expertise required to build a successful career in the IT industry, with a particular focus on cyber security, applicable worldwide. The curriculum integrates theoretical knowledge with practical skills in computing and cyber security. It includes analytical skills for threat assessment, techniques for data collection and analysis for security purposes, as well as the use of modern tools and technologies to implement robust security controls and policies in ICT environments.
Possible career paths as Cyber Incident Responder, Penetration Tester and Cybersecurity Implementer, roles defined by the European Cybersecurity Skills Framework (ECSF).

column1: National University of Political Studies and Public Administration
column5:
The programme is delivered in English and offers an interdisciplinary curriculum covering Cybersecurity, Society and Technology, Security Studies, Introduction to Computer Science, International Regulations of Cyberspace, the Digital Single Market, and Theories of International Relations.
It is designed for students interested in careers in Romanian and EU public institutions, international organisations active in digitalisation and cybersecurity, and the private sector. It also addresses civil servants in central and local public administration, supporting the development of experts able to coordinate the digital transformation of public institutions and services.
Based on its curriculum, the programme can be mapped to the following ECSF role profiles: Cyber Legal, Policy & Compliance Officer, Cybersecurity Risk Manager, and Chief Information Security Officer (CISO). These roles reflect the programme’s focus on cybersecurity governance, legal and policy aspects, risk management, digital transformation, and strategic coordination.

column1: Lucerne University of Applied Sciences and Arts
column2: Master of Science in Information and Cyber Security
column5:
The Master's program "Information and Cyber Security" at the Lucerne University of Applied Sciences and Arts (HSLU) is an international program offered entirely in English. It is a part-time program that spans six semesters, accounting for a total of 120 ECTS credits. The program aims to train highly qualified professionals and leaders. The curriculum emphasizes technical expertise, communication and management skills, as well as the scientific and practical application of knowledge.

This Master's degree is specifically designed for professionals and career changers with work experience in cyber security.
Possible career paths as Chief Information Security Officer (CISO), Cybersecurity Implementer and Cybersecurity Architect, roles defined by the European Cybersecurity Skills Framework (ECSF).

Typical job profiles out of the European Cybersecurity Skills Framework (ECSF) are: Chief Information Security Officer (CISO), Digital Forensics Investigator, Penetration Tester - practically all profiles related to Information Security Management described in the ECSF are being covered.
Students can get involved as junior researchers in R&D projects of the Secure Information Systems Research Group.
column18: ISO27001 Auditor, LIP, MS MCP, Certiport

column5:
The current global context, together with IT market trends and growing demand for cybersecurity expertise, highlights the need for advanced training in this field. The continued rise in cybercrime, the need to train professionals to counter cyber threats, and the importance of presenting clear and effective cyberattack mitigation methods place the Cybersecurity Master’s programme within a well-defined and increasingly relevant area of study, characterised by strong and growing market demand.

The programme aims to provide students with a broad foundation in cybersecurity and familiarise them with the fundamental concepts of information-environment security, including malware, cyberattacks, zero-day exploits, and related threats. Building on this foundation, the curriculum addresses the management of cyber threats affecting the most common technological and business environments.

Based on this focus, the programme is particularly compatible with the ECSF professional profiles of Cyber Threat Intelligence Specialist, Cyber Incident Responder, and Cybersecurity Implementer.

The Master’s programme “Cybersecurity Management” prepares graduates to understand, create, and manage the state of the art information technology environments and human resources in the area of cybersecurity. The programme is centred on management aspects, but also covers legal and technological aspects of cybersecurity. Interdisciplinarity is emphasized during studies. Possible career paths as a Chief Information Security Officer (CISO) or Cyber Legal, Policy & Compliance Officer or Cybersecurity Risk Manager, roles defined by the European Cybersecurity Skills Framework (ECSF).

column1: University of Poitiers, ENSAR (conversion of IRIAF)
column2: Engineering degree in risk management, information system security (conversion of the Master of Information Systems Risk Management)
column5:
Ce diplôme d'ingénieurs de l'ENSAR école interne de l'université de Poitiers, est localisé à Niort au sein de son département du risque et de la donnée. Il est labellisé par la Commission des Titres d'Ingénieur (CTI). Issu d'un savoir faire dans la formation à la SSI depuis 2003, il reprend l'ancien master MRSI déjà labellisé cybersécurité organisationnelle par l'ANSSI. L'ENSAR dispose pour ses étudiants d'un cyber range à vocation civile pour l'entraînement à la gestion des crises d'origine cyber. Des parcours professionnels possibles en tant que Cybersecurity Risk Manager ou Cybersecurity Auditor, rôles définis par le European Cybersecurity Skills Framework (ECSF).
La formation ingénieur gestion des risques est en 3 ans, mais il est possible de candidater sur dossier en année 2.

column1: National University of Science and Technology POLITEHNICA Bucharest, Faculty of Electronics, Telecommunications and Infomration Technology (ETTI)
column2: Security Management of Informational and Communication Equipment and Systems (SMICES)
column5:
The SMICES Master’s Programme was developed in direct response to accelerated digital transformation, the increasing complexity of critical infrastructures, including telecommunications and information technology, and the emergence of hybrid technological ecosystems and next-generation communications, such as 6G. 
The mission of SMICES is to educate engineers specialising in the security of information and communication systems and equipment. Graduates are prepared to design, develop, implement, and manage security solutions for hardware and software infrastructures.
The programme also provides students with the knowledge and practical skills required to apply emerging technologies, including artificial intelligence, virtualisation, the Internet of Things, and quantum communications, to the development of secure and resilient systems.
In relation to the European Cybersecurity Skills Framework (ECSF), SMICES prepares graduates for career paths aligned with the following professional role profiles: Cybersecurity Architect, Cybersecurity Implementer and Cyber Incident Responder.

Our master programme assures the training of specialists with deep theoretic and practical knowledge in the field of cybersecurity. It is developed in cooperation with an important Romanian cybersecurity private company, focused on hands-on assignments and projects, and covers the curriculum of important industry-recognized information security related certifications. Possible career paths as a Cybersecurity Implementer or Cybersecurity Researcher, roles defined by the European Cybersecurity Skills Framework (ECSF).

This unique multidisciplinary three-year professional Bachelor's study degree program includes a guided professional internship and prepares students to get a job right immediately after graduation while those interested can continue in the follow-up Master's study.

column2: Computer Systems, Communication and Security (Information Security Specialization)
column5:
The specialization focuses on areas of security in computer systems and networks, cryptography and its applications. The aim is to prepare such a graduate who will be able to work in a variety of roles critical to ensure security of ICTs – specific profiling (e.g., toward cryptography, technological aspects or security management) beyond a common basis of field of study is left to the choice.
Possible career paths as Cybersecurity Implementer, Cyber Threat Intelligence Specialist and Cyber Incident Responder, roles defined by the European Cybersecurity Skills Framework (ECSF).

column2: European Master in Law, Data and AI (EMILDAI)
column5:
The European Master in Law, Data and Artificial Intelligence (EMILDAI) is an international interdisciplinary programme offered by four Partner Universities, supported by three Research Associate Partners, and involving more than seventy public and private organisations in the delivery of work placements, seminars, thematic weeks and summer schools. EMILDAI is funded by the Erasmus Mundus Joint Master programme of the European Union.
Possible career path as Cyber Legal, Policy & Compliance Officer, a role defined by the European Cybersecurity Skills Framework (ECSF).

The Cybersecurity Bachelor's program trains experts in IT systems security, combining in-depth technical skills, ethical awareness, and hands-on experience. It emphasizes a curriculum aligned with industry demands, including a significant professional integration internship, and prepares students to address cybersecurity challenges effectively.

The Master’s programme in Cybersecurity offered by Babeș-Bolyai University of Cluj-Napoca, Faculty of Mathematics and Computer Science, aims to train specialists capable of addressing the challenges generated by accelerated digitalisation and the increasing number of cyberattacks. The programme adopts an integrated approach to data protection, systems and network security, and software application security, providing students with solid competencies in the analysis, design, and implementation of secure solutions.

The curriculum combines theoretical foundations, including cryptography, risk management, web security, and network security, with practical applications and modern technologies, such as cloud computing and distributed systems. The programme places strong emphasis on vulnerability identification, attack prevention, and the use of advanced protection methods, while being aligned with industry requirements and European standards.

The Master’s programme offers internship opportunities and applied projects, facilitating graduates’ rapid integration into the labour market. Graduates are prepared to take on roles such as cybersecurity experts or consultants.

Possible career paths as Cybersecurity Implementer, Cybersecurity Architect and Cybersecurity Risk Manager, roles defined by the European Cybersecurity Skills Framework (ECSF).

The Cybersecurity master's degree study program is a key master's degree study program in computer science, information and communication technologies at the TU of Košice. The program is aimed at university research and cooperation with industrial practice.
Graduates of the Cyber Security study programme acquire the ability to analyse systems in terms of security, complexity, and efficiency, and to design appropriate algorithmic solutions for critical components. They are equipped to specify, design, implement, and maintain modern software systems, as well as to analyse and modify existing ones. A graduate can work effectively within a professional development team, demonstrate leadership capabilities, stay up-to-date with the latest advancements in the field, and continually expand their knowledge throughout their career.
Possible career paths include, among others, Penetration Tester and Digital Forensics Investigator, roles defined by the European Cybersecurity Skills Framework (ECSF).

The Cybersecurity study programme equips students with the ability to analyse security threats to computer and information systems, implement information security solutions, apply principles of human-computer interaction in IT system design, use tools for software development, and operate computer and software systems efficiently and effectively.
Graduates of the first-level Cybersecurity programme are fully prepared to continue their studies at the second level in Cybersecurity or related disciplines.

Cette formation vise à former des experts du domaine de la conception conjointe « matériel-logiciel » de systèmes électroniques sécurisés. Les diplômés seront des cadres supérieurs capables d’appréhender, c’est-à-dire de modéliser, de concevoir, de gérer, de maintenir  ou  d’optimiser  des  systèmes  embarqués  ou  intégrés  sécurisés (IoT, sytème cyber-physique, etc.).
Parcours professionnels possibles en tant que Cybersecurity Auditor, Cybersecurity Implementer et Cybersecurity Researcher, des rôles définis par le European Cybersecurity Skills Framework (ECSF).

column2: National Security - Cyber​​security and protection of classified information
column5: The Cybersecurity and Classified Information Protection programme is adapted to the latest standards in the dynamically changing cyberspace. Graduates acquire knowledge and skills enabling them to take up work related to information security management, identification of threats and counteracting them, development of security systems, IT audit and security inspection of classified and personal data. Students will gain skills to effectively manage information security in an organization or provide cybersecurity services. Possible career paths as Chief Information Security Officer (CISO) or Cyber Legal, Policy & Compliance Officer, roles defined by the European Cybersecurity Skills Framework (ECSF).

You will learn, in just one year, all you need to start working in any cybersecurity field, in a practical manner, with personalised attention from expert professors in reduced groups, in touch with the cutting-edge of the discipline and doing internships at top Spanish companies.

Possible career paths as Cybersecurity Auditor or Cybersecurity Risk Manager or Cybersecurity Architect, roles defined by the European Cybersecurity Skills Framework (ECSF).

column2: Computer Engineering, Cybersecurity and Artificial Intelligence
column5:
This program addresses the current industrial and societal challenges, requiring the design, deployment, and maintenance of secure cyber-physical systems empowered by artificial intelligence. This computer engineering program will expose students to cybersecurity concepts, methodologies, and techniques in the interplay between system engineering, software development, and artificial intelligence.
Possible career paths as a Chief Information Security Officer (CISO) or Cyber Threat Intelligence Specialist or Digital Forensics Investigator, roles defined by the European Cybersecurity Skills Framework (ECSF).

This course provides students with the computer network know-how to build secure and efficient networks and understand how hackers work. You will gain the knowledge to defend and manage the network by developing security plans, strategies and technical solutions to protect computer networks which includes physical and virtual servers and network hardware configuration. You will learn through hands on experience with Windows & Linux operating systems, services, scripting, databases, ethical hacking, virtual machines, microservices, Cisco and cloud technologies

column1: Faculty of Information Studies in Novo mesto
column5: Master's study programme Cyber Security is a study programme that will equip graduates with in-depth knowledge of the use of information and communication technologies in the business operations of organisations, methods and techniques of protection and safeguarding organisations, their information systems and employees against cyber threats. Graduates will acquire a comprehensive set of complementary skills that will enable them to know the methods and tools for monitoring the success of cyber protection implementation, the correct requirements and related legislation, as well as the methods of cyber security assessment or audits. Possible career paths as Cybersecurity Educator, Cybersecurity Researcher and Penetration Tester, roles defined by the ECSF.

Help make our digital world safer
In the Bachelor Cybersecurity Professional, you study specific problems in the field of security and learn how to arm yourself against them. As a cyber security specialist you will be trained in the very latest technologies and techniques in the field of cyber security, cyber crime and cyber warfare. Cyber security specialists provide more security and privacy in the digital world.
Our course is supported by the Cyber Security Coalition non-profit organisation and listed in the Cybersecurity Higher Education database powered by ENISA, the European Union Agency for Cybersecurity.
This bachelor is taught entirely in English.
Kickstart your career in cyber security now!

In the three-semester Master's degree programme Enterprise and IT Security, you will gain knowledge in IT security , organisational enterprise security as well as ethics and Law. 
    In the course of the programme, you will both gain thorough practical experience and improve your scientific-academic skills. Besides the purely technical aspects of protecting IT systems, the organisational and legal framework conditions receive more focused attention as well. You will discuss relevant current security questions in small groups and directly apply and evaluate them in the lab.
Possible career paths as Cybersecurity Auditor or Cybersecurity Architect or Cybersecurity Risk Manager, roles defined by the European Cybersecurity Skills Framework (ECSF).

column2: MBA in Advanced Cybersecurity Technologies & Governance
column5:
The MBA in Advanced Cybersecurity Technologies & Governance at École des Ponts Business School is an 18-month, 90 ECTS programme designed for experienced professionals seeking to lead secure digital transformation and build cyber-resilient organisations. The programme integrates cybersecurity, business strategy, AI, digital trust, governance, regulation, risk management and organisational resilience, enabling participants to translate complex technical and regulatory challenges into executive-level decisions. Through core management courses, specialist cybersecurity electives, applied learning, case analysis and an Integrative Business Project, participants develop the strategic judgement and leadership capabilities required to govern cyber risk effectively. Delivered primarily online with hybrid elements, the MBA combines academic expertise, applied research, and industry insight through a multidisciplinary European teaching ecosystem developed within the EU-iNSPIRE project.
Possible career paths as a Chief Information Security Officer (CISO), Cybersecurity Risk Manager and Cyber Legal, Policy & Compliance Officer, roles defined by the European Cybersecurity Skills Framework (ECSF).

For alle virksomheter er det helt avgjørende at den digitale infrastrukturen fungerer. Etter dette studiet vil du være en av dem som sørger for det.

Possible career paths as Digital Forensics Investigator, Cybersecurity Architect and Cybersecurity Auditor, roles defined by the European Cybersecurity Skills Framework (ECSF).

The Master's Program in Computer Science Cyber Security and Machine Learning (CSML) offers strong foundations in cyber security and advanced machine learning techniques, preparing graduates as experts in computer and network security, data protection, software development, and AI systems. 
Students learn to design, implement, secure, and manage complex systems, analyze data, and apply machine learning to detect and prevent threats. Key skills include software and database security, cyber risk analysis and management, applying machine learning and data mining, implementing cryptography and secure protocols, and managing distributed, cloud, and web systems securely.
Graduates are prepared for the ECSF role Cybersecurity Implementer, as well as ESCO occupations such as ICT Security Administrator, Data Scientist and Artificial Intelligence Engineer, Security Automation Engineer or Threat Intelligence Analyst.

column2: Mestrado em Segurança Informática (Masters in Information Security)
column5:
The program runs for two years.
In the first year students attend 10 courses, 6 of which are mandatory and 4 of which are selected from a set of elective courses.
Mandatory courses: Theory and Practice of Security Attacks, Applied Cryptography, Network Security, Data and Systems Security, Security and Applications of Trusted Hardware and Security in Software Engineering.
In the second year, the students attend two additional mandatory courses: Information Security Management and Law&Privacy.
The remaining 48 ECTS are dedicated to a dissertation project in the second year.
Possible career paths as Cyber Incident Responder, Cybersecurity Researcher and Penetration Tester, roles defined by the European Cybersecurity Skills Framework (ECSF).

column1: Zealand, Academy of Technologies and Business
column5: This program specializes in IT security, training you to protect digital infrastructure and data against hacker attacks while ensuring systems remain operational. The curriculum covers three core areas—cybersecurity management, network security, and software security—combining theoretical teaching with project work and a mandatory six-month internship. Graduates are qualified for roles such as IT security consultants, advisors, or specialists within both private companies and public organizations.

column1: National University of Science and Technology POLITEHNICA Bucharest
column5:
The programme is intended for graduates holding a bachelor’s degree or an equivalent qualification in Computer Engineering and Information Technology, with at least three years of professional experience in IT. It aims to provide advanced knowledge and develop practical skills in cybersecurity.

The curriculum has been developed in cooperation with industry partners CompTIA and EC-Council. Through these partnerships, students will benefit from industry certifications offered by the partners, including CompTIA Security+, EC-Council Certified Ethical Hacker (CEH), CompTIA Cybersecurity Analyst (CySA+), and EC-Council Computer Hacking Forensic Investigator (CHFI).

Completing the programme also provides the opportunity to qualify as a certified cybersecurity auditor, in accordance with the applicable legal provisions.
Based on its stated curriculum, certifications, and professional outcomes, the programme is most closely aligned with the following ECSF profiles: Cybersecurity Auditor, Penetration Tester, Digital Forensics Investigator.

Possible career paths as a Chief Information Security Officer (CISO) or Cybersecurity Architect or Cybersecurity Risk Manager, roles defined by the European Cybersecurity Skills Framework (ECSF).

The combination of distance learning but with on-campus days allows flexible learning but with face-to-face interactions.  The programme has an expert teaching team and builds on UCD's deep cybercrime and digital forensics experience.

University of Passau offers a M.Sc. program in Computer Science with a specialization in Cybersecurity - out of 120 ETCS, at least 75 come from the specialization area (30 credits thesis, 5 credits seminars and 40 credits lectures on Cybersecurity). The languages of instruction are German and English, the programme can be studied entirely in either language, or in a combination of the two.
