• Ochrona wartości: W przeciwieństwie do klasycznych studiów MBA, skupiamy się nie tylko na wzroście i optymalizacji zysków, ale przede wszystkim na zabezpieczeniu wygenerowanej wartości oraz stabilnym, bezpiecznym rozwoju organizacji kluczowych dla funkcjonowania państwa.
• Elitarni partnerzy: Program realizujemy we współpracy z DKWOC, Stowarzyszeniem CyberMBA, ISSA Polska oraz Fundacją Bezpieczna Cyberprzestrzeń.
• Spójny program: Wiedzę przekazujemy w formie logicznej, komplementarnej opowieści, którą zwieńczy praktyczny projekt wdrożeniowy.
• Ekspercka kadra: Około 40 wybitnych praktyków przekaże esencję wiedzy i unikalne, rynkowe know-how. Każde zajęcia to niepowtarzalna wartość.
• Wyjątkowy networking: Budujesz relacje z liderami, którym zależy na bezpieczeństwie najważniejszych polskich podmiotów. Integracja i wymiana doświadczeń to siła napędowa naszych edycji.

Companies and state services have a growing need for professionals capable of understanding the threat and the operating methods of attackers and building secure infrastructure (technical, organizational and human), in order to better protect themselves and manage cyber crises. The government, via the National Information System Security Agency (ANSSI) and the various Military Programming Laws (LPM), makes training in Cyberdefense a priority in France.
Cyberdefense engineering training, developed with companies and offered through apprenticeship, is a response to this important need.
Possible career paths as defined by the roles of the European Cybersecurity Skills Framework (ECSF): 
- Cybersecurity Risk Manager
- Cybersecurity Implementer
- Cyber Incident Responder

column1: University of Ljubljana Faculty of Electrical Engineering
column2: Electrical Engineering, Information and Communication Technologies Major
column5:
Z izbiro študijske smeri »Informacijske in komunikacijske tehnologije« (IKT) in »Modula J« magistrskega študijskega programa boste pridobili širok spekter znanj s področja Kibernetske varnosti, vključno z znanji za zaščito sistemov in omrežij, strojno in programsko opremo, računalništvom v oblaku, kriptografijo ter interdisciplinarnimi vidiki. 

Na teh tematikah boste nadaljevali tudi v okviru dela na raziskovalnih projektih in magistrskega dela. Študij na fakulteti lahko dopolnite z dodatnim izobraževanjem in pridobitvijo profesionalnih certifikatov, npr. Cisco, Juniper.

column1: Zealand, Academy of Technologies and Business
column2: Bachelor of IT Security (Topup PBA i it-sikkerhed)
column5:
The bachelor's degree in IT security (210 ECTS) provides the candidates with skills, knowledge and tools to help prevent and combat threats in the digital world. 

The students learn how to identify weaknesses, build security into products and draw up guidelines for good security measures and behavior when working online. And if the accident happens, then it is also you who takes action.

Possible career paths as a Cybersecurity Implementer or Cyber Legal, Policy & Compliance Officer or Cybersecurity Risk Manager, roles defined by the European Cybersecurity Skills Framework (ECSF).

column2: CYBERUS Erasmus Mundus Joint Master in Cybersecurity
column5:
The CYBERUS EMJM in Cybersecurity is an Erasmus Mundus jointly delivered by Université Bretagne Sud (UBS, coordinator), France, Université du Luxembourg (UNILU), Luxembourg and Université Libre de Bruxelles (ULB), Belgium. It has a strong focus on cybersecurity (105 ECTS out of 120) while offering a broad base of cybersecurity skills at UBS and two specialisation tracks: IoT Cybersecurity (with mobility to ULB) and Software Cybersecurity (with mobility to UL). Students will also conduct a 5-month internship at an approved institution anywhere in the world. The programme also includes a Winter School in Estonia at TalTech and a Spring school with a CTF and scientific presentations.
After two years, graduates will be awarded double degrees, either between UBS and ULB for the IoT Cybersecurity track or between UNILU for the IoT Software track.
The programme offers scholarships and fee waivers to the best students. It also strongly invites female students to apply.
Possible ECSF (European Cybersecurity Skills Framework) career paths: 
- Cybersecurity Architect
- Cybersecurity Implementer
- Cybersecurity Researcher

It is a very practice-oriented program. Our graduates get very interesting jobs in industry (Pentration Tester, CISO, Threat Hunter, Secure Software Developer). We always have winners in the Austrian Cyber Security Challenge (ACSC).
Possible career paths as Penetration Tester or Cyber Threat Intelligence Specialist, roles defined by the European Cybersecurity Skills Framework (ECSF).

column1: University of Warsaw, Faculty of Political Science and International Studies
column5: Celem studiów jest kształcenie absolwentów posiadających kompetencje do pracy na stanowiskach w obszarze cyberbezpieczeństwa w firmach i instytucjach państwowych, takich jak: Cyber Incident Responder, Cybersecurity Auditor (role określone przez European Cybersecurity Skills Framework - ECSF). Studenci uczą się diagnozować i analizować zagrożenia związane z cyberbezpieczeństwem oraz stosować narzędzia służące do ich ograniczania i eliminacji. Kształtowanie umiejętności zawodowych ma na celu sprostanie stale zmieniającym się wymaganiom cyfrowego świata wynikających z rozwoju technologii informatycznych, rynku IoT i wzrostu popularności pracy zdalnej.

column2: Master Universitario en Ciberseguridad e Inteligencia de Datos
column5: Este Máster oficial se desarrolla en tres bimestres, con el 50% de las materias dedicadas a Ciberseguridad. En el cuarto bimestre se desarrolla el Trabajo Fin de Master y las Prácticas Externas en empresas. Las clases presenciales son algunas semanas, siempre de lunes a viernes entre las 16:00 o las 17:00 hasta las 20:00. Las asignaturas incluyen: Criptografía,  Identidad Digital, Seguridad de las Comunicaciones y por Internet, Consultoría y Auditoría, Programación Segura y Hacking Ético y Análisis Forense. El título cubre varios roles del ECSF para que el alumno pueda desarrollar posibles trayectorias profesionales, entre los cuales destacan los top three (3) de Cybersecurity Educator, Cybersecurity Implementer y Cybersecurity Researcher, además de los de Auditor y Digital Forensics.

Possible career paths as Cybersecurity Architect, Cyber Incident Responder and Penetration Tester, roles defined by the European Cybersecurity Skills Framework (ECSF).

column1: Università degli Studi eCampus | CyberSecurity Italy Foundation
column5:
Il Master in Management & Cybersecurity è un programma di un anno, erogato interamente online, che mira a formare professionisti nella gestione della sicurezza informatica e del rischio. Gli studenti acquisiranno competenze in ambito di sicurezza ICT, cyber intelligence, gestione del rischio e sicurezza cloud. Il Master è rivolto a chi intende lavorare nel settore della cybersecurity, focalizzandosi su competenze pratiche e conoscenze rilevanti per il settore.
Possibili percorsi di carriera come Chief Information Security Officer (CISO), Cybersecurity Risk Manager e Cyber Incident Responder, ruoli definiti dall'European Cybersecurity Skills Framework (ECSF).

Organisations and society are going through digitalisation at all levels which raise significant cybersecurity concerns. Simultaneously, organisations must balance cybersecurity with innovation and effectiveness to meet their business goals and thrive in competitive markets. While technologies play an important role in securing organisational assets, technology alone cannot solve the contemporary cybersecurity issues. What is needed is a holistic approach that can manage the complexity in a responsible and ethical manner.
Possible career paths as Chief Information Security Officer (CISO), Cybersecurity Architect, Cybersecurity Auditor and Cybersecurity Risk Manager, roles defined by the European Cybersecurity Skills Framework (ECSF).

column1: University of Latvia BA School of Business and Finance
column2: Professional master's degree in Cybersecurity Management
column5:
With increasing globalization, security risks, the need for effective management of data, and the demand for information security and intelligence have increased. The program addresses these aspects by explicitly focusing on concepts, frameworks, and management strategies of cybersecurity operations, and prepares the student to discover the Information security manager's role. 
The Information Security Manager is an alternative title of the Chief Information Security Officer (CISO), a role defined by the European Cybersecurity Skills Framework (ECSF).
Our program is based on occupation standard. This option highlights the program among academic programs.

column2: Master's Degree in Information Technology, Cyber Security
column5:
Part-time studies. Contacts on weekends approximately three times per autumn semester and three times per spring semesters. Application requirements:

column1: Titu Maiorescu University of Bucharest, Faculty of Computer Science
column2: Security of Information Systems and Information Networks
column5:
The Master’s Programme in Security of Information Systems and Information Networks is designed to provide students with advanced theoretical knowledge and practical skills in the field of cybersecurity.

The programme focuses on understanding security technologies, cyber threats, risks, and the relevant regulatory framework. It also covers the design and implementation of secure software and hardware architectures, database security, web technologies, cloud computing environments, and the application of scientific research methods. In addition, students develop project management, testing, evaluation, and problem-solving skills that are essential for professional practice in IT security.

Based on the competencies acquired during their master’s studies, graduates can pursue a wide range of career opportunities, including roles such as cybersecurity expert, cybersecurity auditor, ICT security administrator, information systems security manager, and specialist in procedures and tools for securing information systems.

As part of the university’s research infrastructure, the Cloud Cybersecurity Centre of Excellence has been established.

Possible career paths as Cybersecurity Implementer, Cybersecurity Risk Manager, and Cybersecurity Auditor, roles defined by the European Cybersecurity Skills Framework (ECSF).
column18: The career opportunities associated with this programme are aligned with the Romanian Classification of Occupations (COR) and may also be mapped to the European ESCO framework for occupations, skills, competences and qualifications: 252904 – Cybersecurity Expert; 252906 – Cybersecurity Auditor; 252908 – ICT Security Administrator; 252910 – Information Systems Security Manager; 252913 – Information Systems Security Procedures and Tools Specialist; 251209 – Cloud Technologies Engineer

column5:
This specialization aims to train specialists with solid theoretical and practical preparation in computer science, information technology, and cybersecurity, preparing them to become professionals in information security.

Students explore network security, focusing on protecting communication networks against unauthorized access, interception, and data manipulation; information systems security, covering the protection of operating systems, databases, and IT infrastructure against attacks and failures; cryptography, addressing data encryption methods; risk analysis and management, involving the identification and assessment of potential cyber threats and the development of mitigation strategies; and cybersecurity incident investigation, covering the detection, investigation, and response to incidents such as cyberattacks and data breaches.

Graduates may pursue careers as Cybersecurity Analyst, Security Engineer, Security Consultant, Incident Response Specialist, IT Security Administrator, or Cybersecurity Researcher, corresponding to the ENISA ECSF profiles of Cyber Incident Responder, Cybersecurity Architect, and Cybersecurity Risk Manager.

column1: Budapest University of Technology and Economics
column5:
Security is one of the major challenges in today's information systems and communication networks. The objective of this IT Security major specialization (which is part of BME's MSc programme on Computer Engineering) is to introduce to the students the main security problems of IT systems and the approaches, methods, and tools used to solve those problems. We put the emphasis on practical applications; however, through the analysis of different security solutions, the students also get familiar with the security analysis techniques and design principles. Those who complete the IT Security major specialization will be able to identify, understand, and analyze security problems arising at different architectural levels of IT systems, to understand and apply typical methods and tools to solve security problems, and to designing and implement new security mechanisms and architectures.

Possible career paths as Cybersecurity Architect, Cybersecurity Implementer and Cybersecurity Researcher, roles defined by the European Cybersecurity Skills Framework (ECSF).

column2: Master of Electrical Engineering (ICT Security and Networks)
column5: The option ICT Security and Networks explores the design of communication networks and ICT security systems. You will learn about cryptography and information security. You will also learn how to develop and manage mobile communication networks from the core network all the way to the antenna elements. Possible career paths as a Cybersecurity Architect or Cybersecurity Implementer or Cybersecurity Researcher, roles defined by the European Cybersecurity Skills Framework (ECSF).

column2: Cybersecurity of Operational Technology (OT) Systems and Technologies
column5:
The mission of the Master's programme "Cybersecurity of Operational Systems and Technologies" is to develop the professional competencies required to train selected military and civilian experts in applying the laws, principles, and norms governing cyber defense in the contemporary civilian and military environment.

The specialization aims to develop the capacity to assess conventional and unconventional risks and threats, to act creatively, and to apply appropriate methods for employing cyber defense-specific structures, as well as to identify and use techniques specific to cyber defense structures regarding the planning, organization, coordination, control, and evaluation of informational actions in the cyber domain.

The objectives of the Master's programme are designed to develop the professional competencies of graduate students in leading and coordinating the management of cyber threats and ensuring cybersecurity, preparing them for roles corresponding to the ENISA ECSF profiles of Cyber Incident Responder, Cybersecurity Risk Manager, and Cybersecurity Architect.
This programme comprises computer science basics, cyber security specialization and a mandatory industry internship.

The MSc in Cybersecurity at Reykjavík University prepares students to address one of today’s most pressing challenges: protecting digital systems, infrastructures, and societies against rapidly evolving cyber threats. As cybersecurity skills are in critical demand across Europe and beyond, this programme provides a solid and explicit foundation in cybersecurity for all graduates. 

You will gain advanced technical knowledge and strategic insight into the prevention, detection, and response to cyber incidents. Core topics include penetration testing, incident response, secure systems design, system resilience, privacy and law, and risk management. Throughout the programme, you will apply specific techniques such as cryptography, secure coding, and machine learning through hands-on laboratories, case studies, and research-oriented projects. In addition, you will develop strong analytical, project-planning, and critical-thinking skills and competencies.

Possible career paths include, among others, Cyber Incident Responder, Penetration Tester and Cybersecurity Researcher, roles defined by the European Cybersecurity Skills Framework (ECSF).

column1: Wojskowa Akademia Techniczna im. Jarosława Dąbrowskiego (Military University of Technology)
column2: Techniczne i organizacyjne aspekty cyberbezpieczeństwa (Technical and Organisational Aspects of Cybersecurity)
column5:
Studia podyplomowe „Techniczne i organizacyjne aspekty cyberbezpieczeństwa” zapewniają zaawansowaną wiedzę oraz praktyczne umiejętności w zakresie ochrony systemów informacyjnych, sieci oraz infrastruktury cyfrowej przed zagrożeniami w cyberprzestrzeni. Program obejmuje kluczowe zagadnienia, takie jak podstawy cyberbezpieczeństwa, aspekty prawne i strategiczne, zarządzanie ryzykiem oraz nowoczesne rozwiązania technologiczne, w tym bezpieczeństwo sieci, systemów operacyjnych, aplikacji oraz środowisk chmurowych.

Słuchacze zdobywają kompetencje w zakresie identyfikacji podatności, analizy zagrożeń oraz wdrażania skutecznych mechanizmów ochrony w różnych środowiskach organizacyjnych, w tym w systemach infrastruktury krytycznej. Program łączy solidne podstawy teoretyczne z praktycznymi zajęciami, obejmującymi m.in. analizę ryzyka, zarządzanie incydentami oraz testy penetracyjne.

Absolwenci są przygotowani do projektowania, wdrażania i zarządzania systemami cyberbezpieczeństwa w organizacjach oraz reagowania na dynamicznie zmieniające się zagrożenia.

Możliwe ścieżki kariery jako Cybersecurity Implementer, Cybersecurity Risk Manager i Cyber Incident Responder, role określone przez European Cybersecurity Skills Framework (ECSF).

column2: MSc in Advanced Cybersecurity Technologies and Governance by Research
column5:
The MSc in «Advanced Cybersecurity Technologies & Governance by Research» is interdisciplinary and cross-disciplinary and focuses on producing original scientific research in the fields of cybersecurity, data protection, and the governance of digital and information environments.
The programme equips students to investigate complex cyber threats, design forward-looking solutions, and contribute to digital resilience, security strategy, and informed policymaking. It is mostly tailored for the ECSF profile of Cybersecurity Researcher, however it also covers disciplines for the rest of the ECSF roles as well.

The MSc in Enterprise Cybersecurity integrates technical and managerial expertise, equipping students to fulfill the market's need for versatile professionals capable of implementing security solutions and leading cybersecurity initiatives.
The curriculum combines technical training with real-world applications, emphasizing hands-on experiences and soft skills development.
The master's also aligns with industry-recognized cybersecurity certifications like CISSP, CISM ad CEH, further enhancing the students' professional qualifications.
Three (3) career paths defined by the European Cybersecurity Skills Framework (ECSF) that this programme could lead to are: Chief Information Security Officer (CISO), Cybersecurity Risk Manager and Cyber Incident Responder

column2: Master's Degree in Computer Security and Artificial Intelligence
column5:
We offer a face-to-face (classroom) master's degree carried out in two semesters.
Compulsory subjects (36 ECTS) cover topics of artificial intelligence and computer security. The remaining, 15 ECTS, are optional and allow specialization in one of the mentioned areas. The average student's workload is 15h per week for a period of nine months. 
Classes are scheduled every day between 3pm and 8pm. 
Possible career paths as a Cybersecurity Researcher or Cybersecurity Implementer, roles defined by the European Cybersecurity Skills Framework (ECSF).

column2: MSc in Information and Communication Systems Security
column5:
The MSc in Information and Communication Systems Security addresses specialists, researchers and executives from public or private administrative or decision-making organisations. The MSc programme aims at training students in the area of information and communication systems security, as well as in privacy protection technologies.
Possible career paths as Chief Information Security Officer (CISO), Cybersecurity Architect and Cybersecurity Implementer, roles defined by the European Cybersecurity Skills Framework (ECSF).

column1: Solvay Lifelong Learning (Solvay Brussels School Economics & Management)
column2: Executive Master in Cyber Security Management
column5:
This program is designed for professionals seeking managerial and practical knowledge across the six domains that form the core pillars of cybersecurity activities and management practices. It is open not only to participants in Belgium but also to applicants from across the European Union and worldwide.

Upon completion, graduates can pursue career opportunities such as Chief Information Security Officer (CISO), Cybersecurity Risk Manager, and Cyber Legal, Policy & Compliance Officer—roles recognized by the European Cybersecurity Skills Framework (ECSF).

column5:
Second-degree studies - specialization in cybersecurity and cloud technologies provide extended knowledge and skills in the field of computer engineering. Graduates will obtain the ability to use information systems engineering methods and design, protect and analyze complex, distributed computer systems, as well as the ability to manage IT projects mainly with reference to cybersecurity issues. The studies allow you to participate in research and development activities in the field of computer engineering with the main scope of cybersecurity. We allow participating in various projects related to the concept of the Internet of Everything (IoE). 
Reference to European Cybersecurity Skills Framework (ECSF): Cybersecurity Architect, Cybersecurity Implementer.

This course has been designed to enable learners from an IT background or non-IT background with relevant work experience to gain a postgraduate qualification in applied computer networks and/or security. The materials covered in the modules have been benchmarked against industry-standard professional certifications to ensure that graduates have in-demand IT industry skill sets. The delivery is broken into 30 ECTS blocks to enable the learner to select the most beneficial to them enabling continuous professional development (CPD). Potential role profiles, as defined by the European Cybersecurity Skills Framework (ECSF), include: Penetration Tester, Cybersecurity Implementer and Cybersecurity Architect.

Además estudia las leyes tradicionales que aun no están adaptadas para su aplicación en el ciberespacio.

column1: Military University of Technology (Wojskowa Akademia Techniczna im. Jarosława Dąbrowskiego)
column5: The programme is almost entirely conducted by the Faculty of Cybernetics and specialises in four fields: cyber defence, information security, IT systems security, and cryptographic systems. We educate specialists in information security systems (risk management, identification and forecasting of security threats and countermeasures, auditing of ICT networks), designers of security systems and security management systems for the military, the Police, banks, businesses and public institutions (methodologies and technologies for ensuring information system security, investigative and forensic techniques, methods of cyber attacks, vulnerabilities of ICT systems), as well as designers and administrators of ICT system security (management of network devices and protocols, administration of operating systems, security design and management in wireless and wired networks, intelligent and agent-based cyber defence, and resilience to cyberattacks), as well as developers of hardware and software cryptographic algorithms (building secure algorithms, researching and assessing the risk of cryptographic breaches including post-quantum cryptography).

Students will gain a strong foundation in the practical and theoretical skills needed to defend networks, computers, applications and organisations from cyber-crime or state-level sponsored attacks. The programme is taught in English.

column2: MSc Software Engineering and Internet Computing - Specialization in Security and Privacy
column5: The specialization in Security and Privacy is offered for the master program "Software Engineering and Internet Computing". The curriculum offers you the opportunity to deepen your knowledge in a variety of topics, such as system security, network security, cryptography, formal methods for security and privacy, and many more, acquiring the background required to become an IT Security specialist with possible career paths as Cybersecurity Auditor, Cybersecurity Researcher, Cybersecurity Implementer, Penetration Tester, roles defined by the European Cybersecurity Skills Framework (ECSF).

column2: Master in Cybersecurity Engineering (MEC) / Mestrado em Engenharia de Cibersegurança
column5:
The Master in Cybersecurity Engineering (MEC) aims to meet the demand of professionals in the field of Cybersecurity and the needs created by European directives and societal challenges related to the security and privacy of companies and citizens.

This course allows student’s to develop their skills in several cybersecurity topics, such as cryptography, privacy, secure communications and infrastructures, software security and risk management.

This master aims to accommodate students who are already in the job market and have significant professional experience (not less than 5 years), operating entirely in a distance learning regime, with a combination of synchronous classes (by videoconference) and asynchronous activities (guided study, laboratory work, case study analyses, group discussions, etc.) that will allow students to develop their skills autonomously. These learning processes will be supported by a remote learning platform.

This first edition of this master will start in September 2026, and admissions are currently open.

Possible career paths, among others, Chief Information Security Officer (CISO), Cybersecurity Architect and Cybersecurity Auditor, roles defined by the European Cybersecurity Skills Framework (ECSF).

The specialisation in Cybersecurity has mandatory courses providing hands-on knowledge, experience and skills to solve complex cybersecurity challenges in today's evolving threat landscape combined with mandatory courses providing core Software Engineering skills. 
The mandatory courses of Cybersecurity specialisation are taught in English.
Possible career paths as Cybersecurity Implementer and Penetration Tester, roles defined by the European Cybersecurity Skills Framework (ECSF).

The program is a comprehensive and practice oriented course that provides students with a strong foundation in the field of cyber security. The program is designed to train students in the analysis, prevention and management of cyber attacks on humans, digital assets, networks, and systems. It covers a range of topics, including cyber law, network security, cryptography, and digital forensics, and provides hands-on experience through practical projects and internships. Additional courses on AI in cyber security or operational technologies, industrial control systems and cloud security, completes the program with most relevant topics. Possible career paths: Cyber Threat Intelligence Specialist and Cyber Incident Responder, roles defined by the European Cybersecurity Skills Framework (ECSF).

column1: Wrocław University of Science and Technology
column5:
Studia na kierunku gwarantują wykształcenie w obszarze bezpieczeństwa sieci oraz systemów informatycznych i telekomunikacyjnych, a także ochrony danych. Kształcimy w zakresie:
- wykorzystania nowoczesnych narzędzi teleinformatycznych (biblioteki programistyczne, sprzęt sieciowy, protokoły komunikacyjne) w projektowaniu i integracji systemów bezpieczeństwa
- praktycznego stosowania narzędzi i technologii związanych z bezpieczeństwem oraz audytowaniem sieci teleinformatycznych w celu zabezpieczania podmiotów gospodarczych i instytucji publicznych
- obsługi i działania aplikacji oraz usług elektronicznych w Internecie oraz sieciach lokalnych, rozwiązań zabezpieczających sieci teleinformatyczne (w tym sieci bezprzewodowe)
- projektowania inteligentnych systemów teleinformatycznych zabezpieczających przez atakami
- zasad działania podstawowych narzędzi kryptograficznych
- bezpiecznego wirtualizowania funkcji sieciowych
- zarządzania systemami operacyjnymi i uodparniania ich na cyberataki
- wdrażania kompleksowego systemu zarządzania bezpieczeństwem informacji
- regulacji prawnych związanych z cyberbezpieczeństwem i zapewnieniem ochrony danych osobowych.

The program is a 60 ECTS credit Master’s degree for students with diverse backgrounds: public administration, law, management, law enforcement, military, and IT graduates are welcome. It is encouraged that the applicant already has a master’s degree before application. The program focuses on security management and global strategy. According to the European Cybersecurity Skills Framework (ECSF), the graduates will be qualified for Chief Information Security Officer (CISO), Cyber Legal, Policy and Compliance Officer, and Cybersecurity Risk Manager roles.

column2: Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity and Artificial Intelligence
column5: El objetivo fundamental es formar a expertos que dispongan de conocimientos y competencias en Inteligencia Artificial y Ciberseguridad y que puedan aplicarlas de modo sólido desde ambos prismas y también de forma conjunta. Desde el impacto de Ciberseguridad en la IA, para que puedan integrar la seguridad en todas las etapas del ciclo de vida de desarrollo. Desde el impacto de la IA en la Ciberseguridad, para que puedan desarrollar técnicas de IA que enriquezcan los métodos que implementan la seguridad de los sistemas, las comunicaciones y los datos.

column1: University of Salerno - Department of Computer Science
column2: Sicurezza Informatica e Tecnologie Cloud - Cybersecurity and Cloud Technologies
column5: Il Corso mira a formare specialisti di cloud security, con approfondite conoscenze di cloud computing e sistemi distribuiti, di sicurezza informatica, di metodologie di sviluppo e manutenzione di sistemi software in cloud e critici dal punto di vista della sicurezza, di tecniche di intelligenza artificiale per la prevenzione delle minacce cyber, ed in grado di garantire la sicurezza e la protezione degli ambienti cloud, le applicazioni su essi eseguite e i dati in essi contenuti, attraverso operazioni di prevenzione, scoperta, mitigazione e recupero da attacchi informatici. A questo scopo, il corso completa la formazione informatica con conoscenze in ambito giuridico e socio economico. Possibile percorso di carriera come Cyber Threat Intelligence Specialist, un ruolo definito dall'European Cybersecurity Skills Framework (ECSF).
column18: There is an agreement with PMI, so students attending the course can access to the first level of PMI certification (CAPM)

column5:
This programme provides the learner with the technical skills required to work in the Cybersecurity Industry. Hands on learning is emphasised and there are no written exams. Network Security, Penetration Testing, Forensics, Incident Response, Risk and Compliance, Cryptography and Scripting form the mandatory modules, while the electives allow the learner to explore Threat Intelligence, Malware, Cloud Security and Distributed Ledger. In addition, each learner will undertake an individual project. Many of the students taking the course are already in employment, and many are in the Cybersecurity space. Each application is individually judged, but, in general, applicants should have an honours degree in Computer Science or in a cognate discipline, and should have a good know ledge of Computer Networking. As the programme is delivered 100% online, the student does not need to reside in or visit Ireland.
Possible career paths as Cyber Incident Responder, Cybersecurity Implementer and Penetration Tester, roles defined by the European Cybersecurity Skills Framework (ECSF).

column1: Zealand, Academy of Technologies and Business
column2: Professionsbachelor i cybersikkerhed (Bachelor of Cyber Security)
column5: This program specializes in IT security, training you to protect digital infrastructure and data against hacker attacks while ensuring systems remain operational. The curriculum covers three core areas—cybersecurity management, network security, and software security—combining theoretical teaching with project work and a mandatory six-month internship. Graduates are qualified for roles such as IT security consultants, advisors, or specialists within both private companies and public organizations.

column1: Norwegian University of Science and Technology (NTNU)
column5:
The main objective of the study programme is to provide students with profound knowledge and skills about the technologies and techniques in digital infrastructure and cyber security, which are required to meet the societal needs for secure, smart and robust communication networks and services.

It is a two-year full-time programme of study (120 ECTS). Each study year is divided in two semesters.

Possible career paths as Cybersecurity Architect, Cybersecurity Implementer and Cybersecurity Researcher, roles defined by the European Cybersecurity Skills Framework (ECSF).

The Cybersecurity programme is adapted to the latest standards in the dynamically changing cyberspace. Graduates acquire knowledge and skills enabling them to take up work related to information security management, identification of threats and counteracting them, development of security systems, IT audit and security inspection of classified and personal data. Students will gain skills to effectively manage information security in an organization or provide cybersecurity services.

Some modules are taught by professionals working at INCIBE (Spanish National Institute of Cybersecurity).
Este máster permite acceder a las siguientes trayectorias profesionales: investigación en ciberseguridad, auditoría de ciberseguridad o pruebas de penetración. Estos roles han sido definidos por el European Cybersecurity Skills Framework (ECSF).

column2: Computer Engineering and Science for Cybersecurity
column5:
The course in Computer Engineering and Science for Cybersecurity was created with the specific intention of providing a concrete response to the "skills shortage" in the field of IT security. The course is therefore designed as a three-year course in order to train specialized technical personnel who can be immediately employed in the cybersecurity sector in the shortest possible time.
The title gives direct access to the profession of consultant for the security of computer systems, data and networks, technician specialized in information technology for the secure management of systems, networks and critical infrastructures, as well as technician specialized in analysis and in the development of applications through the use of cybersecurity methodologies.

column1: Bocconi University and Politecnico of Milano
column2: Master of Science in Cyber Risk Strategy and Governance
column5:
The program gives students the tools required to assess and govern the opportunities and threats of the existing and emerging technologies. It aims at preparing cyber risk and security managers & data protection and security officers in a gender balanced (50% female composition in 2026), international class.
Employment sectors include audit, banking and financial services, consulting, engineering and system integration, healthcare, Information and Communication Technologies (ICT), retail sales, telecommunications, transportations, etc.

99% of graduates employed within 6 months according to self reported data between 2019-2025.

Possible career paths as Chief Information Security Officer (CISO), Cyber Legal, Policy & Compliance Officer, and Cybersecurity Risk Manager, roles defined by the European Cybersecurity Skills Framework (ECSF).

Graduates acquire a comprehensive set of technical skills, gaining the competencies needed to keep any company's information systems, networks, and data safe and secure. Through the master's programme in cybersecurity, students study information technology, cybersecurity theory and management, risk analysis, cryptography, network security, cyberdefense, digital forensics, cybercrime, cyberlaw and policy, data communications and networking, as well as ethics, law and policy.

Upon graduation, they will be able to apply these skills during cybersecurity incidents to help minimize any negative impact. Today, most industries — including finance, healthcare, information technology, and the public sector — face real cybersecurity challenges, meaning that as certified cybersecurity experts, graduates will be able to choose the sector in which to pursue a profitable and successful career, in roles corresponding to the ENISA ECSF profiles of Cybersecurity Architect, Cyber Incident Responder, and Digital Forensics Investigator.

column2: Cyber Security, Master of Science in Technology
column5:
We are a leading Finnish university in cyber security engineering education.This programme is also a part of the EIT Digital Master School Cyber Security double degree programme (both entry and exit). It is the only cyber security programme in Finland to participate in EIT Digital Master School Cyber Security programme. https://masterschool.eitdigital.eu/programmes/cse/

Along with our partners, we also are a partner in the EU project called SPECTRO to deliver advanced digital skills in cyber security and robotics in the form of specialized Master’s programmes and self-standing modules. SPECTRO is funded under the Digital Europe Programme.

Possible career paths (as defined in the European Cybersecurity Skills Framework (ECSF)): Chief Information Security Officer (CISO), Cybersecurity Architect, Cyber Threat Intelligence Specialist.

column1: University of Granada, University of Padova, University of Vilnius, University of Minho
column2: Master in International Cybersecurity and Cyberintelligence
column5:
The Master in International Cybersecurity and Cyberintelligence is a full-time study program jointly developed by four European Universities: Granada (Spain), Minho (Portugal), Padova (Italy) and Vilnius (Lithuania). It seeks to create an excellent environment for developing competencies in this critical area, exploiting mobility mechanisms around the four universities, with solid links to the European business fabric and with the initial support of a European research project, Cyberactioning. For benchmark purposes, the program includes an attack/defense exercise and a scientific event scheduled for the last semester. Based on the ENISA ECSF proposal, the program targets the role profiles:
- Cyber Threat Intelligence Specialist
- Cybersecurity Implementer
- Cybersecurity Research

column1: Kadir Has University (Coordinator-Türkiye), SRH Berlin University of Applied Sciences (Partner-Germany),  Cyril and Methodius University (Partner-North Macedonia)
column2: CyberMACS- Erasmus Mundus Joint Master’s Degree (EMJM) Programme in Applied Cybersecurity
column5: CyberMACS is an Erasmus Mundus Joint Master’s Degree (EMJM) programme in applied cybersecurity offered by a consortium of three highly ranked universities in Türkiye, Germany, and North Macedonia. During the two-year MSc studies, students will study at two of the consortium universities and graduate from both. Our industry partners promote the future employability of CyberMACS students by offering internship, company visits, and contributions to the course contents. CyberMACS is one of the European top-quality Master Courses selected by the Erasmus+ Program (Erasmus Mundus). The programme provides a solid background in the cybersecurity domain and offers possible career paths as a Cybersecurity Risk Manager, Cybersecurity Implementer or Cybersecurity Researcher, roles defined by the ECSF.
